# cat-harness-tools-src

The MCP and HTTP server — what `bun run start` and `.mcp.json` start, from `src/index.ts`: the composition roots (`server.ts`, `route-groups.ts`, `tool-groups.ts`), the plug-in contract `types.ts`, the MCP tool registrars (`tools/`), the harness's own routes (`routes/branches.ts`, `routes/chat.ts`), authentication (`auth/`, `core/github-auth.ts`), access control (`core/rbac.ts`), the MCP projection (`mcp/`) and the no-content adapter. Moved from `cat-harness/src/` in stage 1a's first batch (bean `70lx`, B1). The Tool nodes it serves stay DECLARED in `cat-harness/tools/` with their original `src/tools/*` paths, and the loader finds each module here through `needs` (owner ruling "Trap 1"); the content routes (feedback, glossary, relevance) went UP to `folio-assistant-core/src/routes/` instead (owner, 2026-10-04).

Part of [C@T Harness Tools](../README.md) 0.1.0, declared as `cat-harness-tools-src`, holding `code`.
